name: Email Template Generator
description: Generate responsive HTML email templates from parameters like subject, body, and brand color.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.label: Email Subject
inputs.description: The email subject line (used as the preview heading)

inputs.name: body
inputs.label: Email Body
inputs.description: The main content of the email (supports multiple paragraphs)

inputs.name: brand_color
inputs.label: Brand Color
inputs.description: Hex color for the header and button (e.g., #2563eb)
